statement: SK hynix showed HBM4 at 48GB with 12-high stacks in production and 16-high under qualification, targeting 2048 GB/s across 2048 IOs.
why: HBM4 reaching production is what lets the next accelerator generation ship in volume.

impact.mechanism: Production-stage HBM4 stacks add memory supply and bandwidth for next-generation accelerators, with 16-high still at qualification limiting near-term upside.

evidence.excerpt: HBM4 at 48GB capacity with '12-high in production and 16-high under qualification'

confidence.basis: Secondary conference coverage of a vendor presentation; single outlet.
